entries.title: I Chronicles 28:1
segments: As men draw near the close of life, they should endeavor to communicate such instruction from the word and providence of God, as may be most useful to survivors.

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:4
segments: For ever; that is, in his posterity.  David here refers to the promise, "Thy throne shall be established for ever,"
, which has its perfect fulfilment in Christ.  See notes on

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:7
segments: If he be constant; had Solomon and his successors been constant in God's service, he would have established the earthly kingdom of David without interruption till it should have been merged in Christ, of whom the angel Gabriel said, "The Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David: and he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end."

But for their unfaithfulness the earthly successors of David were rejected for many centuries before the advent of the Messiah. 
 
Fidelity to God is essential to the reception of those blessings which, to the faithful, he has engaged to impart.

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:8
segments: In the sight of all Israel--in the audience of our God; supply, "I charge you."

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:9
segments: To be accepted of God, what men do they must do heartily as unto him, with a willing mind, for his glory and the best good of men.

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:12
segments: By the Spirit; as divinely directed.

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:15
segments: The candlesticks of gold; of these there were ten,
. The candlesticks of silver were for uses less sacred, but which are not stated by the inspired writer.

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:18
segments: Of the chariot of the cherubim; or, "the chariot, the cherubim;" that is, the chariot of God consisting of the cherubim.  Compare
.  The reference is to the two cherubim of olive-wood overlaid with gold, which Solomon placed in the holy of holies, and under the shadow of whose wings the ark was placed.

entries.title: I Chronicles 28:19
segments: In writing; what God showed David with regard to the temple and its furniture, as related from

, it is supposed he wrote down and delivered to Solomon for his guidance. 
 
The Lord will show his believing people all that they need to know; and in folowing his directions, however great or difficult their work, they may undertake it with resolution and go forward with cheerfulness, expecting that in due time he will give them success.
